params.caption: 🕹️ Steam's Australian age check now looks at how old your account is Valve has tweaked age verification for Steam users in Australia so that the age of the account itself now counts. Accounts that are at least nine years old should pass the check, though PC Gamer notes it may not work for everyone. Until now, Australians were mainly asked to link a credit card to unlock mature-rated games. 🕒 Nov 11, 2026 · 04:34 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #Steam #Australia #GamingNews
